info.title: Pingpong
info.summary: Publish messages to the channels of a project, and receive them over Socket.IO.
info.description:
The protocol between Pingpong, the applications that publish and the clients that subscribe.

Applications use the HTTP API, signed with their project's secret. Clients connect over Socket.IO to their project's namespace, `/projects/{project}`, and use the events described by the `Socket*` schemas (see `docs/protocol.md`).

Version 1 (`/v1`) only changes additively: new fields, endpoints, events and enum values, never removed or renamed ones. Request bodies refuse unknown fields, so typos are caught. Responses and event payloads can gain fields: clients ignore the ones they don't know.

The admin API (`/admin/v1`) manages the projects and shows the server's live state, for its operators and its dashboard. It exists only when the server has an admin token (`PINGPONG_ADMIN_TOKEN`), sent as a bearer token; without one, its paths answer 404. Its responses are never cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`).

Errors use `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457).

post.description: Sends one event to the subscribers of one or more channels of the project. Subscribers receive it as a `message` event (`SocketMessage`), once per channel they are subscribed to. Delivery is at most once, except that a client recovered after a short disconnection receives what it missed.

202.description: Accepted: the message is on its way to the channels' subscribers.

post.description: Publishes up to 100 messages in one request, in order. The request is refused as a whole when one message is invalid or too large.

202.description: Accepted: the messages are on their way, in order.

get.description: Returns how many sockets are subscribed to the channel right now. A channel nobody is subscribed to is not occupied: there is no error for an unknown channel.

200.description: The origins clients may connect from.

put.description: Replaces the list of origins clients may connect from, for example when the application adds a domain. Sockets already connected stay connected.

get.description: Answers when the server is up and its database and Redis (when configured) answer. For load balancers and monitoring.

503.description: The database or Redis doesn't answer.

get.description: The server's version, the checks of `pingpong doctor`, and its live connections and channels. Answers 200 even when a check fails: `healthy` says whether they all pass.

post.description: Creates a project with a new key and a new secret. The secret is in this response only: put it in the application's environment.

201.description: The project, and its secret. The secret is only in this response.

patch.description: Changes what the request has, and leaves the rest. `origins` replaces the list. A limit set to `null` goes back to the server's default. Disabling a project disconnects its sockets, on every server, and refuses new ones.

delete.description: Deletes the project and disconnects its sockets, on every server. Its key and secret stop working.

post.description: Gives the project a new secret, for API requests and private channels. The previous one stays valid for the grace period, so the application can deploy the new one first. A second rotation within the grace period drops the secret before the current one.

200.description: The new secret. It is only in this response.

get.description: The channels that sockets of the server that answers are subscribed to, right now.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only the channels whose name starts with it.

200.description: The channels with at least one subscriber, most subscribed first.

get.description: How many sockets of the server that answers are subscribed to the channel right now. A channel nobody is subscribed to is not occupied.

projectKey.name: Pingpong-Key
projectKey.description: The project's public key (`pk_…`). It says which project signed the request.

requestSignature.name: Pingpong-Signature
requestSignature.description: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`, the HMAC-SHA256 of `{t}.{method}.{path}.{sha256 of the body}` with the project's secret (see `RequestSignature`). Requests more than five minutes off are refused.

adminToken.description: The server's admin token, `PINGPONG_ADMIN_TOKEN`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Only for the admin API, never for `/v1`.

Unauthorized.description: No key, an unknown key, or a missing, expired or wrong signature.

Invalid.description: The request is invalid. `errors` lists the messages by JSON pointer.

MessageTooLarge.description: A message is larger than the project's limit, once serialized.

TooManyRequests.description: The project reached its limit of messages per second.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

AdminUnauthorized.description: No admin token, or a wrong one.

Conflict.description: A project with this id already exists.

ProjectId.description: A project's id, also its namespace: `/projects/{project}`.

PublicKey.description: A project's public key. Clients send it when they connect, and applications with every API request.

ChannelName.description: A channel. `private-…` and `presence-…` channels need a signature from the application; any other channel is public.

EventName.description: The name of an event: printable ASCII, without spaces. Laravel's default event names (`App\\Events\\CommentCreated`) fit.

SocketId.description: The id of a Socket.IO socket, as the client reads it (`socket.id`). It stays the same when the socket is recovered.

Origin.description: An origin clients may connect from: a scheme, a host and an optional port, without a path. `*.` before the host allows its subdomains, one level or more, but not the host itself.

channels.description: The channels to send the message to. A socket subscribed to several of them receives it once per channel.

data.description: Any JSON value. The serialized message must fit in the project's limit (10 KB by default).

exceptSocketId.description: A socket that must not receive the message: the one whose action caused it (Laravel's `toOthers()`).

occupied.description: Whether at least one socket is subscribed.

subscriptionCount.description: The number of sockets subscribed right now.

origins.description: Clients that send an `Origin` header must send one of these. A client without one (a native app, a server) is accepted on the key alone.

RequestSignature.description: The `Pingpong-Signature` header of an API request: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`. The HMAC is of `{t}.{method}.{path}.{sha256}` with the project's secret, where `method` is upper case, `path` is the request target as sent (path and query string, without the host), and `sha256` is the hex SHA-256 of the body (of an empty body for a `GET`). Several `v1` values can follow: the request is valid if one of them matches the current secret or, during the grace period after a rotation, the previous one.

ChannelSignature.description: What the application gives a client to join a private channel: the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `{socketId}:{channel}` with the project's secret. In PHP: `hash_hmac('sha256', "$socketId:$channel", $secret)`.

SocketAuth.description: The `auth` of the Socket.IO handshake, on the namespace `/projects/{project}`.

SocketConnectError.description: The `message` of the `connect_error` a client receives when Pingpong refuses its connection. `unknown_project`, `invalid_key`, `origin_not_allowed` and `project_disabled` are final: the client stops reconnecting. `too_many_connections` is not: it retries.

SocketConnected.description: The `pingpong:connected` event, the first one a socket receives after each connection, recovered or not.

recovered.description: Whether the socket was recovered with its channels and what it missed. When it wasn't, the client subscribes again and reloads what it shows from the application.

SocketSubscribeRequest.description: The `subscribe` event, sent by the client with an acknowledgement.

SocketSubscribeError.description: `unsupported_channel`: presence channels are not supported yet. `too_many_channels`: the socket reached its limit of channels.

SocketUnsubscribeRequest.description: The `unsubscribe` event, sent by the client with an acknowledgement (`{ "ok": true }`).

SocketMessage.description: The `message` event: a message published to a channel the socket is subscribed to.

data.description: The JSON value that was published, if any.

SocketSubscriptionCount.description: The `pingpong:subscription_count` event: how many sockets are subscribed to a channel. Sent to its subscribers when the count changes, at most once every few seconds per channel.

ProjectSecret.description: A project's secret. It signs API requests and private channels, and is never sent to clients.

maxConnections.description: Sockets connected to the project at once, on one server.

maxMessagesPerSecond.description: Messages the project may publish per second, one per channel.

maxChannelsPerSocket.description: Channels one socket may subscribe to.

OwnLimits.description: The limits a project sets itself. The others are the server's defaults.

maxConnections.description: Sockets connected to the project at once, on one server.

maxMessagesPerSecond.description: Messages the project may publish per second, one per channel.

maxChannelsPerSocket.description: Channels one socket may subscribe to.

LimitsPatch.description: Limits to set. `null` goes back to the server's default.

maxConnections.description: Sockets connected to the project at once, on one server.

maxMessagesPerSecond.description: Messages the project may publish per second, one per channel.

maxChannelsPerSocket.description: Channels one socket may subscribe to.

ProjectStats.description: What the server that answers counted for the project since it started (`since`). Kept in memory: a restart starts them again.

peakConnections.description: The most sockets connected at once.

connectionsRefused.description: Connections refused, by reason (`SocketConnectError`). A reason that never happened is left out.

channels.description: Channels with at least one subscriber right now.

messages.description: Messages published: one per channel of each publish request.

bytes.description: Bytes of the messages published, serialized.

rateLimited.description: Publish requests refused because the project reached its limit of messages per second.

AdminProject.description: A project, as its operators see it. Never with its secret.

disabled.description: A disabled project refuses connections and API requests.

origins.description: The origins clients may connect from. Empty: any client that has the key.

limits.description: The limits that apply: the project's own, or the server's defaults.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until when the previous secret still works after a rotation. `null`: only the current one works.

origins.description: The origins clients may connect from. None: any client that has the key.
Replaces the origins. Empty: any client that has the key.

disabled.description: `true` disconnects the project's sockets and refuses new ones.

gracePeriod.description: Seconds the previous secret stays valid. The server's `PINGPONG_SECRET_GRACE_PERIOD` when left out; `0` drops it now.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until when the previous secret still works. `null`: it no longer works.

status.description: `skipped`: not configured, such as Redis on one server.

ServerStatus.description: The state of the server that answers, for its operators.

connections.description: Sockets connected right now, every project.

channels.description: Channels with at least one subscriber right now, every project.

type.description: URI of the problem type. `about:blank` when the status says it all.

errors.description: Validation errors: messages by JSON pointer to the invalid value in the request body (`/messages/3/channels/0`). The empty pointer is the body itself.
